clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm keeps recruits equipped and local messages moving through Coldridge Valley. He helps young mountaineers stay warm, fed, and informed in the harsh mountain conditions.

Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm meets new dwarven and gnomish recruits near the tavern. Coldridge Valley is cut off by winter blizzards and faces dangers nearby. Sten provides green apprentices with sturdy gear so they can face the snow prepared.

Sten gathers wolf hides to make winter clothing and handles messages in Coldridge Valley. He carries dispatches through dangerous Coldridge Pass and delivers official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers across the basin. Troggs block the tunnels, but young warriors, priests, and mages still need their instructions.
